case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both sides. Demo Gießerei GmbH has always valued our long-standing partnership, and our skilled team takes great pride in delivering the highest quality castings for your business.

For a 24-month agreement starting 1 February 2027 with 30 days payment, we can offer €51.50 per unit. Under our Angebot, this is a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Guten Tag, we are pleased to provide the requested quotation for the 60-day payment term, which we can offer at €51.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. As a family-run foundry, extended payment terms require us to bridge the financing gap, which is reflected in this calculation. We remain open to discussing the 30-day variant further should you prefer our standard payment terms.

Our family has always valued the long standing relationship between our companies, and we take great pride in delivering quality work from our foundry to support your business.
